newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Pao de Acucar shr issue to raise $130 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pao de Acucar shr issue to raise $130 mln.

text.p: Brazil's Pao de Acucar supermarket group said it plans to raise at least $130 million via a new share issue, including a Level Three American Depositary Receipt (ADR) program.
Pao de Acucar said in a statement it plans later this month to issue 6.5 billion shares, or roughly 8.55 percent of its total capital stock, in Brazil, Europe and the United States.
"The goal is to raise $130 million to $150 million," the statement said.
The company plans to begin a roadshow Tuesday to promote the issue in Brazil, Europe and the United States. It expects to conclude the share offering by May 28.
The objectives of the share issue are to consolidate the opening of the company's capital, improve liquidity for investors in its stock and list on the New York Stock Exchange, it added.
"The Pao de Acucar group will be the first Brazilian retailer to list its name on the New York Stock Exchange" as well as being one of the first Brazilian companies to do so, the statement said.
Shares of Pao de Acucar, known formally as Companhia Brasiliera de Distribuicao, now trade over-the-counter in the United States as a Level One ADR.

The group first opened its capital to investors in October 1995, raising $112 million through the issue of 10.2 billion shares or 14.6 percent of total company stock. Issued at a price of 10.50 reais, the shares have risen 100 percent in a year and a half.
The money raised in the first public offering was used to partly fund Pao de Acucar's 730 million real investment program for 1996-1998.
In 1996, the firm had net sales of three billion reais and a profit of 120.7 million reais, up some 57.6 percent from the prior year.
